task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write the Bernstein-Vazirani circuit for hidden string '1101111' directly in OpenQASM 3 (no Python circuit building - generate the QASM text), load it with qiskit.qasm3, and verify the recovered string. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
